leaf.text: HRESET selectively resets the prediction history of current logical CPU. This CPUID leaf enumerates the hardware components which supports selective prediction history reset.

ebx.desc: Supported HRESET EAX bits / IA32_HRESET_ENABLE MSR bits
ebx.text:
Enumerate the bits that can be set at the IA32_HRESET_ENABLE MSR to permit selective resetting of a specific hardware component's hardware-kept (prediction) history using the HRESET instruction.
This CPUID register also implicitly enumerates the supported HRESET EAX bits, since HRESET emits a #GP if that register has any set bit that is not also set at the IA32_HRESET_ENABLE MSR.

bit0.desc: HRESET of Intel thread director is supported
bit0.text: Intel thread director was originally called EHFI, Enhanced Hardware Feedback Interface; e.g., at the Intel Architecture Instruction Set Extensions and Future Features May 2021 version. Intel marketing later called it "Thread Director." Thus, some open-source tools still refer to this bit as "ehfi".
